description: This file contains a Python class `GitLabClient` that provides methods for interacting with the GitLab API to fetch files, list directories, and manage repository data, specifically tailored for use within the larger project, including support for authentication, ref selection, and file retrieval.

classes.name: GitLabClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with GitLab's API to perform file operations and repository management.

methods.name: __init__(self, config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Initializes the GitLabClient with configuration parameters such as project identifier, access token, auth method, and refs (branch/tag).

methods.name: str _file_raw_url(self, file_path: str, *, ref: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Constructs the URL for accessing the raw content of a file at a specific ref.

methods.name: str _file_json_url(self, file_path: str, *, ref: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Constructs the URL for accessing the JSON (base64-encoded) content of a file.

methods.name: str _tree_url(self, directory_path: str = "", recursive: bool = False, *, ref: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Generates the URL for listing directory contents in the repository.

methods.name: None set_ref(self, ref: str)
methods.description: Overrides the ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA) for subsequent API calls.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_file_content(self, file_path: str, *, ref: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches file content from GitLab, trying raw access first, then falling back to JSON base64 decoding.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_file_content_via_json(self, file_path: str, *, ref: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fallback method to get file content from the JSON API if raw fails.

methods.name: List[str] list_files( self, directory_path: str = "", file_extension: str = ".prompt", recursive: bool = False, *, ref: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Lists files in a directory, filtered by extension, optionally recursively.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_repository_info(self)
methods.description: Retrieves information about the GitLab project/repository.

methods.name: bool test_connection(self)
methods.description: Tests the connection and access rights to the GitLab project.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_branches(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the list of branches in the repository.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_file_metadata(self, file_path: str, *, ref: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches minimal metadata about a specific file, such as content type and size.

methods.name: close(self)
methods.description: Closes HTTP resources used by the client.
